No correction was discovered by the attribution study itself (it attributed, it did not find); none is recorded as found by a reviewer's or the user's question.\par
\textit{Note.} Corrections 1--13, 19 and 20 predate the claims table's 'before' state (commit 07f9f56, 2026-10-09 20:03): their effects are inside the 'before' column, so no claims row records them. 14--17 were applied jointly in the first final re-run and 18 alone in the FGO-only re-run; a claims row is listed against the batch that changed it, not attributed to one correction, except the directly traced plain-wall case (row 8, 18 and 14), the ruled O partial attribution (rows 21--22: $\approx$93\% 14, $\approx$7\% 15) and flight 2 of the standard-sensor dataset (17, by elimination).\par
\textit{Note.} Included beyond the pack's 18: 19, the FGO trajectory-writer typo (D10), which changed stored FGO yaw values ($\le$ 0.17\textdegree{}) but no numbers.md row at its printed precision; and 20, the re-lock-time redefinition.
